items.title: Frank Amacker Interview, 1960-09-30
items.q: Not to play music, but she taught me vocal music.

ctx.x: What did Ms. Lewis teach you? Ms. Lewis, she taught music. Yeah, but I mean what did she teach you personally? Did she teach you music in general? No. Or one particular instrument?
Not to play music, but she taught me vocal music. I was in the class that she's teaching in. Come around and teach all the pupils in the class like that.
That's it. Oh, you'd all sing it once or one at a time?
